messages:
From: Carla Mendez <carla.mendez@fintrust.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II - exception follow-up and temporary controls

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the call last week. The audit team requested a short note from Redwood describing the current remediation status for the two findings flagged in the March control testing (user provisioning and backup verification). We also need confirmation that Redwood will accept temporary compensating controls for the audit window (01 Jan 2027 - 31 Mar 2027) so our auditors can close the outstanding exceptions while the permanent fixes are deployed.

Specifically auditor requests:
- Management response summary for each finding
- Evidence map (what evidence/logs we will receive and by when)
- A bridge letter or temporary control acceptance statement signed by an authorized Redwood representative

Can you confirm whether you can provide these by Apr 22 so we can include them in the auditor packet? If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min sync with your security leads.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this is blocking our month-end certification.

Thanks,
Carla
Senior Security Manager
FinTrust Financial

[attachment: auditor_finding_report.pdf (PDF)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Carla Mendez <carla.mendez@fintrust.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - exception follow-up and temporary controls

Hi Carla,

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide what you need and appreciate the deadline. High-level plan below; I’ll follow with the formal management response PDF and a draft bridge letter.

Summary of current status (short):
- Finding 1 (user provisioning): root cause identified in our SCIM sync for an edge role; a hotfix has been deployed to prevent new incidents. Full remediation (automation upgrade + regression tests) is scheduled for completion by 2027-05-12.
- Finding 2 (backup verification): a gap in our weekly restore test automation was discovered; manual restore verifications completed for the audit window and evidence has been captured. Permanent automation will be completed by 2027-05-05.

Temporary controls (proposed for auditor acceptance):
- Daily provisioning reconciliation report (auditable CSV export) covering 01 Jan–31 Mar 2027; available by Apr 12.
- Manual restore verification logs + screenshots for sample restores performed during the audit window; available by Apr 15.
- Escalation contact list and change-control tickets for both remediations.

Delivery plan (what we will send):
1) soc2_management_response.pdf (management responses + timelines) — by Apr 12
2) temp_controls_matrix.xlsx (map of temporary controls to findings) — by Apr 12
3) evidence_index.csv (list of log files + links to S3 buckets or zipped exports) — by Apr 15
4) bridge_letter_draft.docx (for your review; we will sign once finalized) — by Apr 18

If those dates work for you I’ll loop in our SOC automation and legal teams. We can also do a short call with the audit team on Apr 13 to walk through evidence types.

Best,
Markus
VP, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
